documents.text: Pilica, Masovian Voivodeship Pilica is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Warka, within Grójec County, Masovian Voivodeship, in east-central Poland. It lies approximately north-east of Warka, east of Grójec, and south of Warsaw. The village has a population of 210 and lies on the higher, left bank of the Pilica River, about 9 km upstream from where it now joins the Vistula.
